info.name: AskMe.Live Complete API Collection (Mobile & Web)
info.description:
Complete API collection for Ask-Me.Live mobile app developers (Viewer App & Creator App), Web clients, and Third-party integrations.

Includes detailed parameter tables showing **Required** and **Optional** fields, validation rules, token auto-saving scripts, and example responses.

request.description:
### 📌 Viewer WhatsApp OTP Send
Sends a 6-digit verification code to the viewer's WhatsApp number via Fonada WABA service.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `phone` | String | **Required** | 10-digit Indian mobile number (e.g. `9876543210`) or with `91` prefix. |
| `type` | String | **Optional** | Auth intent: `login` (default) or `register`. |

#### Notes:
- Cooldown: 30 seconds before another OTP can be requested.
- Rate limit: 5 requests per 15 minutes.
- In non-production environments, response includes `debugOtp` for mock/local testing.

### 📌 Viewer WhatsApp OTP Verify
Verifies the 6-digit WhatsApp OTP code and issues a JWT Bearer token.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `phone` | String | **Required** | 10-digit mobile number that received the OTP. |
| `otp` | String | **Required** | 6-digit numeric OTP code. |
| `type` | String | **Optional** | `login` (returns JWT + user profile) or `register` (returns verified: true). |

#### Auto Postman Action:
- Upon 200 OK, the test script automatically saves `token` into `{{viewer_token}}` variable.

### 📌 Viewer Registration
Registers a new viewer account with name, email, password, and mobile number.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `fullName` / `name` | String | **Required** | Full display name (min 2 chars). |
| `email` | String | **Required** | Unique email address. |
| `password` | String | **Required** | Strong password (min 8 chars, 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase, 1 number, 1 special char). |
| `mobile` / `phone` | String | **Optional** | 10-digit contact mobile number. |

### 📌 Viewer Login
Authenticates existing viewer using email and password.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `email` | String | **Required** | Registered email address. |
| `password` | String | **Required** | Account password. |

### 📌 Viewer Google OAuth Login / Register
Allows 1-Tap Google Sign-in on mobile apps using Google Identity Services token or access token.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `credential` | String | **Required** | Google ID Token (JWT) or OAuth2 Access Token. |
| `email` | String | **Optional** | Fallback email if already decoded on client. |
| `name` | String | **Optional** | User's full name from Google Profile. |

### 📌 Viewer Truecaller 1-Tap Auth
Authenticates Android/iOS viewers via the Truecaller Mobile SDK.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `payload` | String | **Required** | Encrypted profile payload returned by Truecaller SDK. |
| `signature` | String | **Required** | RSA digital signature provided by Truecaller. |

### 📌 Send Email OTP
Dispatches a 6-digit verification code to the viewer's email address.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `email` | String | **Required** | Valid email address. |

### 📌 Verify Email OTP
Confirms the 6-digit email OTP.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `email` | String | **Required** | Target email address. |
| `otp` | String | **Required** | 6-digit code received via email. |

### 📌 Get Current Viewer Profile
Retrieves full account details for the authenticated viewer.

#### Headers:
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{viewer_token}}` (**Required**)

### 📌 Update Viewer Profile
Updates personal information, bio, username, and social links.

#### Headers:
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{viewer_token}}` (**Required**)

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `name` / `fullName` | String | **Optional** | Display name (2 to 100 characters). |
| `username` | String | **Optional** | Unique handle (3 to 30 chars, alphanumeric + dots/underscores). |
| `bio` | String | **Optional** | Short bio (max 500 characters). |
| `country` | String | **Optional** | Country name (e.g. `India`). |
| `avatar` | String | **Optional** | Image URL or relative path returned by `/api/upload/profile`. |
| `socialLinks` | Object | **Optional** | Key-value pairs for `instagram`, `twitter`, `youtube`, `facebook`, `linkedin`. |
| `mobile` + `mobileOtp` | String | **Optional** | In case updating mobile number with verified OTP. |
| `email` + `emailOtp` | String | **Optional** | In case updating email address with verified OTP. |

### 📌 Upload Viewer Avatar
Uploads avatar profile image via multipart/form-data.

#### Headers:
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{viewer_token}}` (**Required**)

#### Form Data Fields:
| Key | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `avatar` | File | **Required** | Image file binary. |

### 📌 Check Username Availability
Checks if a given handle is available across viewers and creators.

#### Query Parameters:
| Param | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `username` | String | **Required** | Desired handle (3-30 chars). |

### 📌 Change Viewer Password
Updates viewer password given the valid previous password.

#### Headers:
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{viewer_token}}` (**Required**)

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `oldPassword` | String | **Required** | Current active password. |
| `newPassword` | String | **Required** | New password (min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, number, special char). |

### 📌 Delete Viewer Account
Permanently deletes or deactivates the viewer profile.

#### Headers:
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{viewer_token}}` (**Required**)

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `password` | String | **Optional** | Required if account has password auth. |
| `reason` | String | **Optional** | Reason for account closure. |

item.name: Get Public Live Feed & Featured Creators

request.description:
### 📌 Public Live Feed
Returns currently active live donation streams, trending creators, and featured broadcasts for home screens.

### 📌 Dynamic Categories
Returns active content categories (e.g. Gaming, Tech, Music, Education, Comedy) to display on discover pills and dropdowns.

### 📌 Creator Public Profile
Fetches creator bio, social links, follower counts, active streams, and membership tier plans by username.

#### URL Path Variables:
| Param | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `username` | String | **Required** | Creator handle (e.g. `rahul_sharma`). |

### 📌 Past Streams Archive
Returns previously completed live streams and recordings with pagination.

### 📌 Toggle Follow Creator
Toggles following status between the authenticated viewer and target creator.

#### Headers:
- `Authorization`: `Bearer {{viewer_token}}` (**Required**)

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `creatorId` | Integer | **Required** | Unique ID of the creator to follow/unfollow. |

### 📌 Get Followed Creators
Returns all creators currently followed by this viewer.

### 📌 Viewer Questions / Super Asks History
Returns all paid Super Asks, messages, status (Read, Not Read, Replied), and creator replies sent by this viewer.

### 📌 Public VIP Membership Plans
Lists active VIP tiers and channel subscription pricing.

### 📌 Subscribe to VIP Plan
Activates VIP subscription badge and perks for a creator.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `planId` | Integer | **Required** | Target VIP Tier Plan ID. |
| `creatorId` | Integer | **Required** | Creator ID. |
| `gatewayOrderId` | String | **Optional** | Payment Gateway Order ID. |
| `paymentMethod` | String | **Optional** | E.g. `UPI`, `Card`, `NetBanking`. |

### 📌 My Active VIP Memberships
Lists all creators where this viewer has an active VIP badge.

### 📌 Register FCM Device Push Token
Registers Firebase Cloud Messaging token for push alerts (when a followed creator goes live, super ask reply received, etc.).

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `token` | String | **Required** | Device FCM push token string. |
| `deviceType` | String | **Optional** | `android` or `ios` or `web`. |

### 📌 Get Viewer In-App Notifications
Returns notification list for the current viewer.

### 📌 Mark Notifications Read
Marks all unread in-app alerts as read for the current viewer.

### 📌 Creator WhatsApp OTP Send
Sends login / onboarding OTP to Creator's WhatsApp via Fonada WABA.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `phone` | String | **Required** | 10-digit Indian mobile number. |

#### Demo Sandbox:
- Phone number `9999999999` has static OTP `123456` for demo testing.

### 📌 Creator WhatsApp OTP Verify
Verifies OTP and returns Creator JWT Bearer Token.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `phone` | String | **Required** | Mobile number. |
| `otp` | String | **Required** | 6-digit OTP. |
| `isRegister` | Boolean | **Optional** | Set to `true` when completing first-time registration.

Creates a new Creator broadcaster account with automatic wallet creation.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |

### 📌 Creator Login

item.name: Creator Complete Trial Profile (Multipart with Image)

request.description:
### 📌 Complete Creator Trial Profile
Activates 7-day full access for creators verified with Demo OTP.

#### Form Data Fields:
| Key | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `fullName` | Text | **Required** | Broadcaster name (min 2 chars). |
| `email` | Text | **Required** | Email address. |
| `phone` | Text | **Required** | Real personal mobile number (shared demo 9999999999 not allowed). |
| `profile_image` | File | **Optional** | Profile image binary. |

### 📌 KYC Step 1: Instant PAN Verification
Verifies PAN number with NSDL/ITD via Cashfree Verification Suite.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `panNumber` | String | **Required** | 10-character PAN number (e.g. `ABCDE1234F`). |
| `name` | String | **Optional** | Expected name on card for fuzzy name matching. |

### 📌 KYC Step 2: Send Aadhaar OTP
Triggers UIDAI OTP via Cashfree Aadhaar Verification Suite.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `aadhaarNumber` | String | **Required** | 12-digit Aadhaar number. |

#### Response Note:
Returns `refId` which must be passed to the verify OTP endpoint.

### 📌 KYC Step 3: Verify Aadhaar OTP
Verifies the UIDAI OTP code.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `refId` | String | **Required** | Reference ID returned from `send-otp`. |
| `otp` | String | **Required** | 6-digit OTP code sent by UIDAI. |
| `aadhaarNumber` | String | **Optional** | 12-digit Aadhaar number. |
| `name` | String | **Optional** | Expected name for fuzzy matching. |

### 📌 KYC Step 4: Match PAN & Aadhaar Identity
Calculates name match score and DOB validation between verified PAN and verified Aadhaar.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `panName` | String | **Required** | Name on PAN card. |
| `aadhaarName` | String | **Required** | Name on Aadhaar. |
| `panDob` | String | **Optional** | Date of Birth (YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `aadhaarDob` | String | **Optional** | Date of Birth (YYYY-MM-DD). |

item.name: KYC - Verify Bank Account Penny Drop

request.description:
### 📌 KYC Step 5: Instant Penny Drop Bank Verification
Performs a ₹1 penny drop through NPCI/IMPS to verify creator account holder name directly from bank records.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `accountNumber` | String | **Required** | Bank account number. |
| `ifscCode` | String | **Required** | Valid 11-digit IFSC code. |
| `name` | String | **Optional** | Account holder name. |
| `phone` | String | **Optional** | Phone number. |
| `verifiedIdentityName` | String | **Optional** | KYC Name to compare with bank registered name. |

### 📌 Submit Final KYC Application
Saves full verified KYC dossier to creator profile in PostgreSQL.

### 📌 Get Creator KYC Status
Returns verification status: `pending`, `verified`, `rejected`, or `not_submitted`.

item.name: Get All Live Sessions for Creator

query.description: Filter by status: active, closed, or all

request.description:
### 📌 Get Creator Live Sessions
Lists all historical and currently active sessions with donation stats and payment URLs.

### 📌 Start Live Stream Session
Changes session status to `active` and fires push notifications to all followers.

### 📌 Close Live Stream Session
Closes the session, disables new donation payments, and archives statistics.

### 📌 Update QR Status
Toggles QR code display on live overlay between `active` and `paused`.

### 📌 Get Live Stream Questions (Super Asks)
Retrieves list of paid Super Asks with viewer names, amounts, messages, and read status.

### 📌 Reply to Super Ask
Sends creator reply to viewer message and dispatches WhatsApp notification to the viewer.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `donationId` | Integer | **Required** | Target Super Ask / Donation ID. |
| `replyMessage` | String | **Required** | Response text. |

### 📌 Update Donation Status
Marks question as `read`, `not_read`, or pinned on screen.

item.name: Get Live Stream OBS Overlay Data (Public)

request.description:
### 📌 OBS Overlay Stream Data
Used by OBS Studio / Streamlabs browser source to render live questions, QR code, and broadcaster goal.

item.name: Get Live Stream OBS Overlay Audio Alerts (Public)

request.description:
### 📌 OBS Audio Alerts
Polls for instant incoming audio/visual popups when a donation is confirmed.

### 📌 Get Wallet Details
Returns `available_balance`, `pending_balance`, `total_earnings`, and `withdrawn_amount` in INR.

item.name: Get Saved Bank Account & UPI Details

request.description:
### 📌 Get Payout Account
Returns currently registered masked Bank Account and UPI VPA.

item.name: Save Creator Bank Account / UPI (One-time Setup)

request.description:
### 📌 Save Payout Bank Account
Registers creator's payout details. Can be set once; future modifications require raising an admin support ticket.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `accountHolderName` | String | **Required** | Name matching bank records. |
| `accountNumber` | String | **Required** (if no UPI) | Bank Account number. |
| `ifscCode` | String | **Required** (with Account) | 11-digit IFSC code. |
| `upiId` | String | **Optional** | Valid UPI VPA (e.g. `user@okhdfcbank`). |
| `bankName` | String | **Optional** | E.g. `HDFC Bank`. |
| `accountType` | String | **Optional** | `savings` or `current`. |

### 📌 Verify UPI ID Format
Validates UPI VPA structure before submitting.

### 📌 Request Payout Withdrawal
Requests withdrawal of earnings to registered bank/UPI account.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `amount` | Number | **Required** | Minimum withdrawal amount is ₹500.00. |

### 📌 Withdrawal History
Lists past withdrawal requests and payout statuses (`pending`, `completed`, `rejected`, `utr_number`).

request.description:
### 📌 Create Cashfree Payment Order
Initiates Cashfree checkout and returns `payment_session_id` to initialize the Cashfree Mobile SDK (Flutter/React Native/iOS/Android).

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `amount` | Number | **Required** | Donation amount (₹40 to ₹99,999). |
| `sessionId` / `sessionCode` | Any | **Required** | Active live session identifier. |
| `creatorId` | Integer | **Required** | Creator ID. |
| `viewerName` | String | **Required** | Donor name (or Anonymous Supporter). |
| `viewerPhone` | String | **Required** | 10-digit mobile number for WhatsApp alerts. |
| `viewerEmail` | String | **Optional** | Donor email for receipt. |
| `message` | String | **Optional** | Super Ask message text (character limits automatically validated based on amount). |
| `anonymous` | Boolean | **Optional** | Set to `true` to hide name on overlay. |
| `agreedToConsent` | Boolean | **Required** | DPDP compliance acceptance flag. |

item.name: Verify Cashfree PG Payment Order Status

request.description:
### 📌 Verify Cashfree Payment Status
Called by mobile app right after Cashfree SDK returns payment completion.

#### Request Body Fields:
| Field | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `orderId` | String | **Required** | Cashfree orderId returned by `/pay/cashfree/order`. |

### 📌 Direct Viewer Donation Process
Direct transaction confirmation API for custom payment gateways.

### 📌 Upload Profile Picture
Uploads an image file to `/uploads/profiles/` and returns full and relative URLs.

#### Form Data Fields:
| Key | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `profile_image` / `file` | File | **Required** | Image file binary. |

### 📌 Upload Document
Uploads KYC document file (PAN / Aadhaar / Passbook copy) to `/uploads/documents/`.

#### Form Data Fields:
| Key | Type | Requirement | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `document` / `file` | File | **Required** | Document binary. |

### 📌 Upload Multiple Files
Uploads up to 5 files simultaneously.

### 📌 Get All 12 Legal Policies
Returns metadata and links for all published policies (Privacy Policy, Terms, EULA, Refund Policy, Community Guidelines, etc.).
